text.card: A red giant 1,920 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.31 solar masses and 11.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,798 K at its surface.
